responsibility: Implements the deny-by-default lint for unsafe patterns that turn a shared reference into a mutable reference by casting `&T` to `*const T`, then to `*mut T`, and finally dereferencing it, including equivalent uses of the `ptr::from_ref` and `cast_mut` helper APIs. It performs a late expression check over dereference expressions, recognizes these cast chains after peeling blocks, verifies that the original value was a reference, and emits the undefined-behavior diagnostic when interior mutability is not involved.
